COMPILING THE EX-STUDENTS ROSTER.—The first big task of the Committee was to compile a list of living ex-students, for the burning of the College had destroyed all of the records, and the lapse of forty-eight years added to the difficulty. To start with, besides the names used at the cornerstone laying, as a nucleus, a few other names were added to form a list from which to work. A letter was sent to each asking for names. Mr. L. G. Gee compiled a roster from memory as much as possible. This was sent out about July 20, 1938, when the ex-students' list had grown to twenty to thirty names, though some were duplicates. Presently a completion of the alumni catalog of 1887-1888 came to light and furnished more than two hundred extra names but some bore for current address.
